setup.why: Ground-truth check before trusting an empty `configurations` array: does TR-5401273 (the `done` run) actually have configurations/cases attached, or is the array genuinely empty? get_test_run's own contract warns that its `configurations` field 'comes back empty on the older run backend whether or not the run has any — that read fails silently there', so an empty array from ANY endpoint needed corroboration before being trusted.

Corroborate step 1 via an independent read path — the run's own test-case listing — since get_test_run's `configurations` field is documented as unreliable when empty. If the run has 0 mapped test cases, an empty `configurations`/progress array is honest data, not a defect.
Same corroboration for the comparison run TR-5394831 (new_run) — confirms whether the emptiness is fixture-wide or specific to one run.
Independent-path corroboration for TR-5394831's test-case count.

notes:
SIDE-BY-SIDE AS REQUESTED:

(a) NULL-BODY 500 INTERMITTENCY — DOES NOT REPRODUCE ON PROD. 3/3 calls to get_test_run_progress returned clean 200s with well-formed envelopes: TR-5401273 (TR-NNN form), TR-5394831 (TR-NNN form), and TR-5401273 again via the plain-integer form (75057293) as an independent retry. Zero 500s, zero null bodies, across both id forms and both target runs. This is consistent with — and reinforces — the preprod judgement that the null-body 500s were environment intermittency rather than a defect in this capability: if it had been a real parameter- or data-triggered crash, it would be expected to reproduce here too, and it did not. Worth flagging for context: this repo's own findings/get_test_run.md Finding 7 records that a *related* preprod 500 pattern (on the sibling get_test_run, not this capability) was independently retracted after re-test — the broader picture across both capabilities on preprod is 'transient, not reproducible,' and prod's clean 3/3 here is consistent with that broader picture, not just this one capability's isolated 5+ clean retries.

(b) DID THE `done` RUN FINALLY POPULATE `configurations`? — NO, still empty, but now for a CONFIRMED, ground-truthed reason rather than an assumed one. Unlike preprod (where emptiness was simply observed and left unexplained), this probe independently verified via two separate read paths (get_test_run's run header, and list_test_run_test_cases's case listing) that TR-5401273 has ZERO test cases mapped into it at all (`count: 0`), despite being in `run_state: "done"". A run can apparently be marked `done` while holding no cases — 'done' here reflects workflow/lifecycle state, not execution content. The comparison run TR-5394831 is identical: 0 mapped cases, 0 configurations. So neither production fixture run exercises the declared per-item shape (`{id, name, overall_progress_by_status_id: {...}}`) — the item shape (and the single-configuration `overall_progress_by_status_id` breakdown) remains UNVERIFIED on production, for the same class of reason as preprod (no populated data), now with hard confirmation that it is a genuine data-emptiness condition of these two specific fixture runs, not a defect and not the 'older run backend silently drops configurations' failure mode that get_test_run's own contract warns about (that failure mode is specific to get_test_run's `configurations` field, not this capability, and in any case the independent test-case-count corroboration rules it out here — 0 cases really means 0 cases).

CONTRACT SHAPE: the envelope returned (`{success, configurations, info}`) matches the declared all-configurations-form contract exactly on every one of the 3 attempts — no missing required field, no undeclared field. `info` matches the declared paging-block description. No drift found in the part of the contract that could actually be exercised.

VERDICT RATIONALE: per the task's explicit instruction, verdict is UNVERIFIED because `configurations` is still empty even for the `done` run designated as primary subject — the per-configuration item shape and the single-configuration `overall_progress_by_status_id` breakdown were never actually exercised on production, same as preprod. This is not a downgrade from preprod's UNVERIFIED judgement; it is a confirmation of it, now with independently corroborated ground truth (0 mapped test cases) instead of an unexplained empty array, plus resolution of the separate 500-intermittency question in the clean direction (does not reproduce, 3/3). To positively verify the item shape, a different production run with real mapped test cases and configurations would need to be found and probed — TR-5401273 and TR-5394831 as given are not that run.

No writes were made; all calls were GET reads against the two designated target runs and their read-only detail/case-listing capabilities, within the fixture project (PR-18723 / 332537).
